definitions.explanation: A suffix attached to time expressions to indicate an approximate time.

examples.japanese: {三時|さんじ}{頃|ごろ}に{会|あ}いましょう。
{何時|なんじ}{頃|ごろ}{着|つ}きますか。
examples.english: Around what time will you arrive?

examples.japanese: {昼|ひる}{頃|ごろ}{電話|でんわ}します。

notes:
USAGE:
Attaches directly to time expressions without particles.

EXAMPLES:
- {七時|しちじ}{頃|ごろ}: around 7 o'clock
- {昼|ひる}{頃|ごろ}: around noon
- {来週|らいしゅう}{頃|ごろ}: around next week
- {子供|こども}の{頃|ころ}: when I was a child

COMPARISON:
- {頃|ごろ}: approximate time (suffix)
- ぐらい/くらい: approximate amount/degree
- {頃|ごろ} is more natural for clock times

NOTE:
Reading is ごろ as suffix, but ころ in {頃|ころ}に or standalone.

RELATED:
- いつ{頃|ごろ}: around when?
- その{頃|ころ}: around that time
- この{頃|ごろ}: these days
